description: This file contains implementations of wrapper functions around POSIX OS functions such as thread creation, mutex handling, directory creation, and time retrieval, specifically for the 'os_utils' module in a software project.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a detached POSIX thread with a specified name and routine.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_SetDataModelThread
methods.description: Sets the current thread as the data model thread handle for verification.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_IsDataModelThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the data model thread, optionally logging a warning.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateDirFromPath
methods.description: Creates all directories in a given absolute path.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateDirFromFilename
methods.description: Creates all parent directories of a given absolute filename path.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_TimeNow
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds, using monotonic clock if available.
